annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部办公厅; 中国人民银行办公厅; 金融监管总局办公厅
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish coordination mechanisms between commerce and financial authorities at local level
Financial institutions to expand consumer finance for goods, services and new consumption
Use digital RMB smart-contract red envelopes, loan interest subsidies, guarantees and risk compensation
Expand government-finance-enterprise matching and information sharing
Strengthen financial consumer protection and rational borrowing
annotation.summary_en: Notice from China's Ministry of Commerce, PBOC and financial regulator offices on strengthening commerce-finance coordination to boost consumption. It directs financial support for goods, services and new consumption (including 'AI+consumption'), digital RMB red envelopes, information sharing, and consumer protection. Not about robotics.
annotation.title_clean: 关于加强商务和金融协同 更大力度提振消费的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Strengthening Commerce and Finance Coordination to Boost Consumption More Forcefully
